prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D illustration for the story intro of an underground survival game, wide 16:9 composition. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no text.
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the FIRST reference (story scene5) to precisely match the four character reference turnarounds in references 2-5: Esk, Mara, Tobin, Ostra in that order. The same characters as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Keep original scene framing, kneeling poses, character positions and cave/bonfire unchanged. Fix Mara beanie to exactly two plain cream stripes, no zigzags; skin medium brown, thick three-segment auburn braid, moss green coat brown soot apron teal scarf. Esk pointed floppy blue hood, brass goggles, grey scalloped fur, dot eyes; Tobin wide sturdy brown coat, grey-brown trapper fur hat, big scalloped ginger beard and mustard mittens; Ostra white bun spectacles low plum hood quilt shawl with SIX large patches ochre teal cream rust moss plum, coat grey. All heads simple dot eyes no irises; mitten hands. Four characters read as small stout people 2.5 heads tall. Preserve extremely simple flat graphic shapes. Shrink cast group and fire together to 80 percent of existing size around centre lower-middle, leaving calm cave floor bottom fifth and more cave space around group. Seven colour families maximum, no glow.

Use case: illustration-story. Full story scene 5, wide 1920x1080 composition, no borders. The first hearth: underground, Esk, Mara, Tobin and Ostra kneeling round a new campfire on a cave floor, Mara striking the flint, faces warm orange, deep blue darkness all around, breath mist as tiny flat pale wisps. Recognisable stout 2.5-head-tall cast: Esk pointed slate-blue hood grey fur ruff and goggles, rust scarf; Mara ochre striped bobble earflap beanie, auburn braid, medium-brown skin, green coat brown apron teal scarf; Tobin wide brown work coat trapper hat, ginger beard deep-brown skin mustard mittens; Ostra old small hunched with white bun, round spectacles plum hood and quilt shawl of six muted patches. Small people grouped around central campfire in lower-middle with vast deep-blue cave behind. Five to seven colour families. Bottom fifth calm cave floor. No text. Flat graphic shapes, strong silhouettes, depth from layered planes; distant planes lighter and bluer, never blurred. Simple clean ink with big plain fills; restrained paper grain only within fills.
rejected: First full-scene generation was too detailed; edited to broad flat graphic shapes, then corrected cast with actual turnaround references.
